_about: One reader's judgement by reading each hidden test against the four specification documents and the seed files, 2026-10-13. Classes: S stated, U names stated but expected value or behaviour not, R needs a name/default/key/exact string not in the specification, C contradicts the specification. Method and limits: TRIAL.md section 10. Extended 2026-10-14 (round 12, before any Opus run) with chakin, particle-swarm-optimization, readtime, geotext, hone and hybrid-images by the same method and reader; notes in round12-opus/classification/README.md.
